title: "2026 Florida Republican Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

# Extract the precinct result files to a temporary directory and read them in
txt_files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())

raw_gov_rep <- read_tsv(
  txt_files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_select = c(county = 2, office = 12, candidate = 15, party = 16, votes = 19),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party == "REP")
```

## County-Level Vote Margin Analysis

```{r}
# Calculate county vote shares and margin between top two candidates
county_margins <- raw_gov_rep |>
  summarize(votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(county, candidate)) |>
  mutate(
    county_total = sum(votes),
    vote_share = votes / county_total,
    .by = county
  ) |>
  filter(candidate %in% c("Byron Donalds", "Jay Collins")) |>
  select(county, county_total, candidate, vote_share) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = candidate, values_from = vote_share, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    margin = `Byron Donalds` - `Jay Collins`,
    county_key = str_to_lower(county)
  )
```

### Scatter Plot: Byron Donalds vs. Jay Collins Vote Share by County

```{r}
county_margins |>
  ggplot(aes(x = `Jay Collins`, y = `Byron Donalds`, size = county_total, color = margin)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent()) +
  scale_size_continuous(labels = label_comma(), name = "Total REP Votes") +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#2b5c8f",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#c93335",
    midpoint = 0,
    labels = label_percent(style_positive = "plus"),
    name = "Donalds - Collins\nMargin"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "County Vote Share: Byron Donalds vs. Jay Collins",
    subtitle = "Points above the dashed line indicate counties won by Byron Donalds",
    x = "Jay Collins Vote Share",
    y = "Byron Donalds Vote Share",
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Geographic Map: Vote Share Margin Across Florida Counties

```{r}
fl_counties_sf <- counties(state = "FL", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  mutate(county_key = str_to_lower(NAME)) |>
  left_join(county_margins, by = "county_key")

fl_counties_sf |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = margin)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2b5c8f",
    mid = "#f7f7f7",
    high = "#c93335",
    midpoint = 0,
    labels = label_percent(style_positive = "plus"),
    name = "Vote Margin\n(Donalds - Collins)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Republican Primary for Governor: County Vote Margin",
    subtitle = "Difference in vote share between Byron Donalds (red) and Jay Collins (blue)",
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections & U.S. Census Bureau (TIGER/Line)"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
